title: 第15章 报仇之日第16章 报仇之时
content_zh:
次日清晨，阳光明媚。
也是报仇之日。
一个看似平平无奇的少年，走进了清风城。
正是从范城附近赶来的牧帆。
“那…那是牧帆吗？”
有人怀疑是不是看花眼了，用手拉了拉身旁的人。
“牧帆你个头，他怎么可能……”
身旁的人一脸不耐烦，但是转头说到一半，硬生生止住了，目送牧帆从旁边走过，这才懵逼的开口：“我去，还真是牧帆！”
“听说两个月前，牧帆可是灭了范城的林家！”
“看这方向，似乎是要去牧府，估计有好戏可以看了！”
“……”
牧帆走得不快不慢，年纪尚小，眼神却是深邃，仿佛什么事也不会让他的内心起一丝波澜。
很快，他径直走到了牧府前。
在他身后，已经跟着不少准备看好戏的人。
牧府门口处，两个守卫脸色瞬间一变。
“你在这儿等着，我去通知族长他们！”
其中一个反应快，直接溜入府邸。
剩下的那个守卫心中暗骂一声，他强装镇定，实则虚得很，笑着问道：“牧帆，你这是？”
牧帆走上前，“滚开！”
“好的。”

守卫弯腰站到一旁。
牧帆径直走进牧府。
入眼是武炼场，牧族的族长牧海雄，以及三大长老，族中高层都已经纷纷到来。
牧海雄露出一抹笑容，“小帆啊，你的修为恢复了？”
牧帆没有理会牧海雄，眼神直盯着大长老。
牧海雄极为不爽，不过忍住了，道：“牧帆，当初你沦为废人，本族长为牧族的未来考虑，废除你少族长的身份，这不是很正常吗？”
牧帆压制住杀意，收回目光，望向牧海雄，“很正常。”
他要弄明白，两次刺杀，都有哪些人参与！
闻言，牧海雄继续道：“是，本族长承认，对你说的话确实很难听，但是你也清楚，这个世道本就如此，本族长自认为并没有做错什么！”
“可是你，却因为此事怀恨在心，杀了牧山与牧河，还扬言要灭了牧族，让我们不得不追杀你，发布悬赏令！”
“不过，如今你可以重修武道，本族长可以给你一个回头的机会，只要你认个错，你依旧会是牧族的少族长！
！”
此言一出，惊到很多不知情的人。
人群之中的牧成虎，更是嫉妒得双眼通红。
牧帆眉头一皱，道：“族长恐怕是搞错了，我之所以杀牧山与牧河，是因为他们两个受牧成虎的指令想要杀我，还有，我从来没有说过要灭整个牧族之类的话！”
牧成虎咆哮道：“牧帆，你别血口喷人，我可从来没有让他们二人去杀你！
！”
牧建阳也道：“牧帆，你该不会是觉得我儿子夺你的光环，所以诬陷他吧？”
牧帆冷笑，“那样的人，只会是你们，我可不屑去做这种事！”
对于牧成虎，牧海雄也是了解一些的，顿时起了几分怀疑，“牧帆，这些都无所谓了，只要你认个错，本族长不计前嫌，让你当牧族的少族长。”

“族长，您可不能这么做，牧帆丧心病狂，杀我们族人，绝对不能放过！”
牧山的母亲跑出来，大声说道。
“一个妇道人家懂什么，赶紧滚！”
content_en:
The next morning, the sun was shining brightly.
It is also the day of revenge.
A seemingly ordinary young man walked into Qingfeng City.
It was Mu Fan who came from near Fan City.
"Then...is that Mufan?"
Some people suspected that they were being dazzled and pulled the person next to them with their hands.
"Mufan is your size, how could he..."
The person next to him looked impatient, but turned around and stopped mid-sentence. He watched Mu Fan walk by, and then said in confusion: "I'll go, it's really Mu Fan!"
"I heard that Mu Fan destroyed the Lin family in Fan City two months ago!"
"Looking in this direction, it seems that we are going to the Mu Mansion. There is probably a good show to watch!"
"..."
Mufan walked neither fast nor slowly. He was still young, but his eyes were deep, as if nothing would make him feel any emotion.
Soon, he walked straight to the Mu Mansion.
Behind him, there were already many people who were ready to watch the show.
At the entrance of Mu Mansion, the expressions of the two guards suddenly changed.
"You wait here, I'll inform the clan leader and them!"
One of them reacted quickly and slipped directly into the mansion.
The remaining guard cursed secretly in his heart. He pretended to be calm, but in reality he was very weak. He asked with a smile: "Mufan, what are you doing?"
Mufan stepped forward and said, "Get away!"
"Okay."
The guard hunched aside.
Mu Fan walked straight into the Mu Mansion.
What comes into view is the martial arts training ground. Mu Haixiong, the leader of the Mu clan, as well as the three elders and the senior members of the clan have arrived one after another.
Mu Haixiong showed a smile, "Xiaofan, has your cultivation level recovered?"
Mu Fan ignored Mu Haixiong and stared directly at the great elder.
Mu Haixiong was extremely unhappy, but he held it back and said, "Mu Fan, when you were reduced to a useless person, my clan leader considered the future of the clan and abolished your status as the young clan leader. Isn't this normal?"
Mu Fan suppressed his murderous intent, withdrew his gaze and looked at Mu Haixiong, "It's normal."
He wanted to find out who was involved in the two assassinations!
Hearing this, Mu Haixiong continued: "Yes, I admit that what I said to you is indeed unpleasant, but you also know that this is the way the world is. I believe that I have done nothing wrong!"
"But you, because of this matter, held a grudge, killed Mu Shan and Mu He, and threatened to destroy the Mu clan, so we had to hunt you down and issue a reward!"
"However, now you can re-cultivate martial arts, and this clan leader can give you a chance to turn back. As long as you admit your mistake, you will still be the young clan leader of the herdsmen!
! "
As soon as this statement came out, many people who were unaware of it were shocked.
Mu Chenghu among the crowd was so jealous that his eyes turned red.
Mu Fan frowned and said, "I'm afraid the clan leader made a mistake. The reason why I killed Mu Shan and Mu He was because they wanted to kill me under the orders of Mu Chenghu. Also, I never said that I wanted to destroy the entire herd!"
Mu Chenghu roared: "Mu Fan, don't slander anyone, I never asked them to kill you!
! "
Mu Jianyang also said: "Mu Fan, do you think that my son has taken away your halo, so you framed him?"
Mufan sneered, "The only people like that are you, I don't even bother to do such a thing!"
Mu Haixiong also knew a little about Mu Chenghu, and he suddenly became a little suspicious, "Mu Fan, these don't matter, as long as you admit your mistake, the leader of this clan will ignore the past grudges and let you be the young leader of the Mu clan."
"Clan leader, you can't do this. Mu Fan is crazy and wants to kill our clan members. You will never let go!"
Mushan's mother ran out and said loudly.
"What does a woman know? Get out of here!"
